title: Spec check (spec/<id>.check.json)
description: Written by `sdlc check-record` after the fresh reader of the spec-check step answered, and updated by `sdlc check-resolve` (design 4.3). body_fingerprint is the spec body the reader read (fingerprint.body_fp); the settled check does not compare it with the current spec, so editing the spec after the check does not re-run the reader. reader says whether the reader ran fresh or degraded (inline). visit, when present, is the spec-check visit the record was made in: a new visit (a changed design.md) starts a new record. Each question is settled by a pile: answered (the answer went into the spec), minor (the main loop decided; author_call is true) or theirs (the user answered, answer_seq names that answer record in questions.jsonl, or the author decided with no user to ask; author_call is true). The settled check passes when every question has a pile; an empty questions list is settled.
